# Happimess

> Happimess designs home organization, storage furniture, and trash management products that balance function, style, and everyday practicality. NYC-based brand founded 2020. Products ship to the 48 contiguous US states. Testing methodology: 30-day evaluation, 500+ pedal/sensor cycles, 15-day odor containment test before any product recommendation.

## Store

- [All Products](https://happimess.com/collections/all-products): Complete catalog of trash cans, storage furniture, organization accessories, and kitchen products
- [Trash Cans](https://happimess.com/collections/trash): Full trash can collection — sensor, step, dual compartment, push button, indoor/outdoor
- [Trash Bags](https://happimess.com/collections/trash-bag): Scented and unscented drawstring trash liners — lemon and lavender scents available
- [Sensor Trash Cans](https://happimess.com/collections/sensor-trash-cans): Touchless sensor-activated trash cans for kitchen and bathroom
- [Step Trash Cans](https://happimess.com/collections/step-trash-cans): Foot pedal step-open trash cans — soft-close lid models available
- [Dual Compartment Trash Cans](https://happimess.com/collections/dual-compartment-trash-cans): Side-by-side trash and recycling bins with removable inner buckets
- [Waste Bins](https://happimess.com/collections/waste-bins): Smaller bathroom, office, and bedroom waste bins
- [Kitchen & Bathroom](https://happimess.com/collections/kitchen): Dish racks, drawer organizers, cabinet organizers, paper towel holders, shower shelves, cutting boards
- [Organization](https://happimess.com/collections/organization): Bins, baskets, cubes, trays, carts, hampers, shoe racks, under-bed storage
- [Storage Furniture](https://happimess.com/collections/storage-furniture): Storage trunks, storage benches, storage stools, shelving, outdoor storage furniture
- [Subscribe & Save](https://happimess.com/collections/subscribe-save): Subscription program for Happimess trash liners — recurring delivery at reduced price
